answer: Gate emission behind a blind dual-panel re-grade held in escrow. The epoch beacon draws one panel; a second independent panel is drawn from a fresh beacon and never shown the first verdict — a commit-reveal bridge. Payout releases only when both medians agree within tolerance; that agreement is the anchor freeing the escrow. While honest graders outnumber a ring, a fresh draw is unlikely to be captured twice, so a farm that swayed the first panel watches its jade fakes diverge on the second and get slashed.
